notes.title: Brand New Multiplayer Modes and New Robot Pack DLCs Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27886209/2a2fd29273f5fc020e2cb78cb0dc4ca8dcf207e9.jpg[/img]

[h1]*** UP TO 70% DISCOUNT TO CELEBRATE NEW FEATURES ***[/h1]
[h1]ALL FOR ONE[/h1]
We've added another two new multiplayer modes to Insane Robots, bringing the total to six. All For One brings a single endurance battle mode to local and friends two-player battles. This really lets you build up your strategy, prepare your hand, and perhaps set up a surprise Special Boost move. But look out! Late game turns can create unexpected changes on everyone's robots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27886209/483ae73a715a2f9c9016720d0f1e7cdda2689097.jpg[/img]

[h1]FAST 'N FURIOUS[/h1]
The second new mode is Fast 'n Furious, which brings three fast-paced cash battles to local and friends two-player battles. Turns are fast in this mode, as you only have 30s to act. Also life is low - all robots start with only 5 health. If you can keep up with the pace, you can make the moves to max the cash - go for overkill, damage, chains, and cash tokens to stay ahead of your opponent.

[h1]ROBOT PACKS 5 AND 6[/h1]
Unbelievably, we were so busy with the above, we forgot to let you know that we've also released two new Robot Pack DLCs. Each pack unlocks 4 robots, playable in local, friends and online multiplayer modes plus (NEW!) single-player quick battles. Every robot has 20 spoken insults you can throw at your opponents in the heat of battle!

[b]If you own Insane Robots Deluxe Edition or Season Pass, these packs will already be unlocked in your game.[/b]

Each pack is $2.99 on Steam, and gives you the following new robots:

[h1]Robot Pack 5[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27886209/6aeb72b1474a68123e81b32e79b544831edc84ea.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/647170/Insane_Robots__Robot_Pack_5/
Promo: http://playni.ac/ir-promo-dlc5

* Scramble - Wakey waaakey…
* Darf Darf - Its bite is worse than its bark
* Ceph - Tentacled and highly advanced multi-tasker
* Unit 09785 - Waste disposal unit that thinks you are trash

[h1]Robot Pack 6
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27886209/ee8d4d443086ca9d00d71e19111a72059ee18763.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/647171/Insane_Robots__Robot_Pack_6/
Promo: http://playni.ac/ir-promo-dlc6

* Cutlaz - Arisen from the black seas of infinity
* Kröm - Assassin. Hitbot. Contract scrapper.
* Icebox - Rogue cryo-science bot
* Cypod - It's got its eye on you

[h1]OTHER STUFF[/h1]
There are also some tweaks and fixes in this build. Normal and Tricksy modes now both unlock tokens a bit faster, and AI robots cannot now unlock the Cloud and Clear achievement for you - oops!

notes.title: New Feature: Deck Info
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27886209/652ea2458fc7782904e17a1fb8ce96ba35d99c51.jpg[/img]

The new Insane Robots Deck Info feature gives you the inside scoop on what's in the game's battle deck and how it works. We wanted to show you a bit more about it. Plus, here's a surprise for many players: The game's decks have never been fully random! 🎲⠀

Deck Info is available to all players from the title screen. The new panel, with five informative sections, shows:
[list]
[*] The number of each type of token in the looping Token Deck
[*] The number of each value of fuel in the looping Fuel Deck
[*] When and how Ubers and Special Boosts appear in your deck
[*] Methods to win and maximise cash from battles, crucial in tournaments or the new Max the Cash 2P mode
[/list]
This inside info lets you optimise your game and become a true Insane Robots master! But don't tell everyone...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27886209/1c687d7df7519faec4728cd80dfaf5709684ff55.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Massive FREE update: MAX THE CASH multiplayer mode, TRICKSY and ROBO-SLAYER difficulty levels

notes.title: Insane Robots V1.0.6 Update: Volume Controls and Fast Loading!
notes.content:
We've been listening to some of your feedback in the Steam forums and on our Discord (http://playni.ac/discord). We've been hard at work today to bring some much requested features (and a couple of fixes) to Insane Robots for a first day update. So here goes!

We've:

* added volume controls! Just simple volume setting for music and sound effects in both options and pause menus.
* added a “fast load” mode, that fast skips loading screens if you don’t want to read the help info there; there's a new toggle button on the options and pause menus. The game will also automatically switch to fast load mode after a while (but this can be disabled in options).
* added arrows to tournament complete and quick battle complete panels to subtly signal how stars are earned.
* fixed the leaderboard paging and number of entries.
* stopped 0 scores being entered in the leaderboard
* corrected text errors in 2 stories.

Insane Robots V1.0.6 is out now. Enjoy the day one update!

Some of you have been asking the very good question "What is in the Insane Robots Deluxe Edition?" (which has a 20% launch discount this week). So here's a picture of exactly what you will get. If you buy the Insane Robots Deluxe Edition you will receive the base game plus all six robot pack DLCs when they are released. 

Over the next few months we are releasing the following robot packs, each with four robots:

* Robot Pack 1 - Veneron, K3-DDP, Mugsoy and Zafarb
* Robot Pack 2 - Raakter, DUM-E, Myuuz and Trasztor
* Robot Pack 3 - Fazarb, Hydro, Tazac and Baron
* Robot Pack 4 - Cazstore, F0-X1, CAM-0 and Leon 
* Robot Pack 5 - Scramble, Darf Darf, Ceph and Unit 09785
* Robot Pack 6 - Cutlaz, Kröm, Icebox and Cypod  


Each robot pack unlocks four robot skins for use in local and online multiplayer game modes.
